children.name: Lunulites latdorfensis Stoliczka, 1862
children.description: Colony small, discoidal, always preserved intact. Autozooecia in very regular concentric rows, about 4 - 5 per colony. No budding from the fragments observed. Autozooecia roundly rectangular with granular frontal wall. Orifice semicircular. Vibracula small, acutely triangular. Dorsal side comprising sectors as wide as an autozooecium and arranged more or less radially, slightly chaotically curved. Only one row of pores per sector.
